title: Death Claim Figures for Term Life Insurance
content:
**Claims manual schedule — Term Life Insurance.** These figures apply on the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term and on the Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 alike.

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Contestability period (from the issue date, or from the reinstatement date for reinstatement statements) | 2 years |
| Suicide exclusion period from the issue date | 2 years |
| Death claim interest rate (simple, annual, from the date of death to disbursement) | 0.035 (3.5%) |
| Premium paid for any period beyond the policy month of death refunded with the proceeds | yes |

During the contestability period a claim is reviewed for material misrepresentation; during the suicide exclusion period death by suicide limits the benefit to a refund of premiums paid.
